failures.fix: Fix the heartbeat detection logic in sw-cleanup.sh to scan and report stale heartbeat files during dry-run, and ensure the summary block prints 'Found' count and '--force' suggestion when items are detected

failures.root_cause: sed command in sw-code-review-test.sh passes substitution expression as filename instead of -e argument, likely due to missing -e flag or incorrect quoting
failures.fix: Change sed invocation to use -e flag: `sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"` instead of `sed "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"`

failures.pattern: mktemp: failed to create directory via template ‘/tmp/claude/sw-test-XXXXXX’: No such file or directory
failures.root_cause: mktemp fails because /tmp/claude directory does not exist on this runner
failures.fix: Add 'mkdir -p /tmp/claude' before mktemp calls, or use 'mktemp -d' without a subdirectory template

failures.root_cause: sed command references a literal variable name '$TEST_TEMP_DIR' as a filename instead of using it as a shell variable in the substitution expression
failures.fix: Quote the sed expression properly so $TEST_TEMP_DIR expands as a shell variable before sed receives it, e.g. use double quotes: sed "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"
